items.title: The official GTA VI destination
items.summary: Find the latest official game information from Rockstar Games.
items.body: Visit Rockstar's official GTA VI page for current announcements, platform details, trailers and game information. Vice World is an independent fan companion.

items.title: Get ready for your next session
items.summary: A short checklist before you jump in.
items.body:
Check your console library and installation progress. Review available game and console updates. Charge your controller and test your audio.

Use the launch checklist in Today to save your preparation progress. Add a personal goal in My Hub's play journal so you know what you want to explore next.

items.title: Need help with the game?
items.summary: Keep your error message handy and consult official support.
items.body:
For technical game issues, consult Rockstar Support. For purchases and licenses, contact the store where you bought the game.

Vice World cannot access or recover your console saves or Rockstar account.
